reviews.title: Amazing battery
reviews.text: Battery easily lasts 8 hours of music and the case gives three more charges. Sound is clear with solid bass. Pairing with my phone was quick.

reviews.title: Great for the price
reviews.text: Good sound quality and impressive noise cancelling for the price. The touch controls are a bit sensitive, I pause music by accident.

reviews.title: Left earbud disconnects
reviews.text: The left earbud disconnects from bluetooth every few minutes on my laptop. Annoying lag when watching videos too.

reviews.title: Comfortable for running
reviews.text: Comfortable fit, they never fall out of my ears when I run. Easy setup with the app.

reviews.title: Mic is poor
reviews.text: Music sounds nice but the microphone is poor on calls, people say I sound far away. Battery is fine.

reviews.title: Case broke after a month
reviews.text: The charging case hinge broke after one month and the plastic feels flimsy. Seller support took two weeks to reply about the warranty.

reviews.title: Solid everyday earbuds
reviews.text: Solid build, fast charging over USB-C, and the case fits in a small pocket. Delivery arrived in two days.

reviews.title: Best value earbuds
reviews.text: Best value I have found. Sound and battery both beat my old pair that cost twice the price.

reviews.title: Hurts after an hour
reviews.text: The fit is not comfortable for me, my ears hurt after an hour even with the small tips.

reviews.title: Crispy fries every time
reviews.text: Fries come out crispy and the chicken cooks evenly. Much faster than my oven. Very easy to use.

reviews.title: Great but a bit loud
reviews.text: Cooks food evenly and the basket is dishwasher safe, which makes cleaning simple. The fan is loud though.

reviews.title: Coating is peeling
reviews.text: After three months the non-stick coating on the basket started peeling. Disappointed for the price.

reviews.title: Perfect size for two
reviews.text: Perfect size for two people. Easy controls and the presets work well. Delivery was fast and the box was well packed.

reviews.title: Plastic smell at first
reviews.text: There was a strong plastic smell for the first few uses. It went away and now it cooks fine.

reviews.title: Arrived dented
reviews.text: The package arrived dented and the fryer would not turn on. Refund took a long time, customer support was unhelpful.

reviews.title: Easy to clean
reviews.text: Easy to clean and cooks evenly. The instructions are short but the app has good recipes.

reviews.title: Worth every baht
reviews.text: Worth the money. I use it every day for chicken and vegetables and it is still quick and quiet enough for my small kitchen.

reviews.title: Fixed my back pain
reviews.text: The lumbar support is excellent and my back feels much better after long work days. Very comfortable seat cushion.

reviews.title: Good chair, hard assembly
reviews.text: Comfortable and sturdy chair, but assembly was hard and the instructions were confusing. Took me an hour.

reviews.title: Squeaks after two weeks
reviews.text: The chair started to squeak after two weeks whenever I lean back. Annoying in video calls.

reviews.title: Great armrests
reviews.text: The adjustable armrests and headrest are great. Build quality feels durable and solid for the price.

reviews.title: Seat too firm
reviews.text: Good back support but the seat cushion is too firm for me. Fine for a few hours.

reviews.title: Broken part in the box
reviews.text: One armrest arrived cracked and the box was damaged. Waiting three weeks for a replacement from the seller.

reviews.title: Good value
reviews.text: Good value compared with expensive brands. Mesh back keeps me cool and the wheels are quiet on wood floors.

reviews.title: Comfortable for gaming
reviews.text: Comfortable for long gaming sessions and easy to adjust the height. Delivery was quick.
